purpose: Define the browse structure for the Acupoint Directory so users can navigate by channel, body region, and common clinical topic instead of relying only on search.

browse_layers.use_case: NCCAOM review, channel-based study, and classical organization.
Fast clinical lookup by anatomical area and point-location study.
Bridge acupoints to patterns, conditions, formulas, case notes, and future treatment plans.

content_import_rule: Chinese and English websites may inform field structure and topic mapping, but AcuTing records should be rewritten, translated, and cross-checked before being marked source_checked or public_ready.
mobile_rule: Directory filters must collapse above the card list on narrow screens and remain touch-friendly.
